field_principles.action_effect_prediction_delta: measures whether the primitive improves transition prediction rather than replay credit.
field_principles.arc_solve_credited: false keeps live reproduction gains as generalization evidence only.
field_principles.baseline_live_levels_reproduced: submitted-path baseline known-level live reproduction count, not new solve credit.
field_principles.confidence_intervals: paired uncertainty is reported for every aggregate delta.
field_principles.field_principles: every Exp5753 field carries its audit rationale so the live-registry A/B is schema-stable.
field_principles.game_blind_receipts: static and runtime canaries prove no game identity, source, adapter, or oracle signal entered the primitive.
field_principles.game_identity_leak_count: admitted game-identity leaks must be zero; detected rejected canaries are reported separately.
field_principles.honest_verdict: terminal complete:/blocked:/retired: verdict accepts safe nulls and blocked gates.
field_principles.live_level_reproduction_delta: primitive minus baseline; any increase is reachability evidence only.
field_principles.live_policy_path: names the submitted E3/StepwiseExplorer path rather than an orphan solver.
field_principles.outer_loop_re_used: false excludes off-path exhaustive reverse engineering.
field_principles.paired_trial_manifest: baseline and primitive arms share games, seeds, observations, resets, budgets, and stopping rules.
field_principles.per_game_metrics: per-game rows expose levels, prediction accuracy, valid/repeat rates, coverage, planning, crashes, exhaustion, actions, time, and receipts.
field_principles.planning_reachability_delta: planned-state reachability is the live induction target.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: structured gates fail closed before live work on provenance, registry saturation, environment reachability, budgets, seeds, resources, and submitted path.
field_principles.primitive_live_levels_reproduced: primitive-arm known-level live reproduction count, not new solve credit.
field_principles.primitive_live_reachable: true only when the primitive is installed through the live E3 policy/explorer route.
field_principles.production_default_enabled: false keeps the unpromoted primitive out of submitted defaults.
field_principles.public_game_count: fixed denominator for the full public registry.
field_principles.random_seeds: paired trials are deterministic only under fixed seeds.
field_principles.registry_level_count: fixed saturated level denominator; used only as context.
field_principles.registry_precheck: confirms 25 public games and 183 levels were already complete, so no public level is new credit.
field_principles.repeated_action_rate_delta: looping behavior is measured separately from validity.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: content-addressed artifact catches silent metric or receipt drift.
field_principles.retirement_signal: repeated normalized-gate blocking retires the line rather than weakening gates.
field_principles.selected_primitive_hash: hash-links the selected primitive to its frozen Exp5740 effect payload.
field_principles.selected_primitive_id: at most one frozen Exp5740 primitive is selected by the pre-registered utility rule.
field_principles.selection_rule: deterministic utility and tie-break rule prevents post-hoc primitive choice.
field_principles.solve_provenance: development_proxy -- known public-registry live A/B, not hidden-game self-discovery credit.
field_principles.source_leak_count: admitted source leaks must be zero; detected rejected canaries are reported separately.
field_principles.spec_refs: REQ/SCENARIO anchors make the measurement traceable to OpenSpec.
field_principles.test_commands: records verification commands used for the artifact.
field_principles.test_exit_codes: records command exit codes rather than prose-only verification.
field_principles.unique_state_coverage_delta: exploration coverage movement is reported even on level-null outcomes.
field_principles.upstream_artifact_hashes: Exp5740/5741/5745/5727 and registry inputs are content-addressed before use.
field_principles.valid_action_rate_delta: validity change is explicit so pruning/ranking failures are visible.
